devices.title: LED Controllers
devices.description: ESP RGBWW LED controllers to expose as Matter lights.

name.title: Name
name.description: Device name shown in the Matter controller.

hostName.title: IP Address / Hostname
hostName.description: IP address or host name of the LED controller.

transitionMs.title: Transition Time (ms)
transitionMs.description: Fade duration for color and brightness changes.

useEventServer.title: Use Event Server
useEventServer.description: Receive state changes instantly from the controller's JSON-RPC event server (TCP port 9090). Falls back to polling when the server is not available.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (s)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Interval for reading the controller state via HTTP.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.
